comments: NormHarbor uses static HTML analysis. The methodology page lists every rule and what is out of scope (JavaScript-rendered content, keyboard traps, focus visibility, contrast from CSS classes): https://normharbor.com/en/methodology
features: Online checker that fetches a web page and statically analyses its HTML against WCAG 2.1 A/AA rules (alt text, labels, names, headings, language, ARIA references and more). Shows a score, issues by severity and how to fix each one. Paid plans add scheduled monitoring and regression alerts. Does not evaluate JavaScript-rendered content.
title: NormHarbor
